title: IVG Smart Max Blue Razz Lemonade Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Blue Razz Lemonade delivers a vibrant blend of sweet Blue Raspberry and sparkling Lemonade. The tangy berry note is bright and juicy, lifted by a zesty citrus finish that adds an effervescent edge to the profile. It's a punchy, fresh and fruity combination that balances sharpness with sweetness in every delicious puff. This IVG Smart Max refill pack contains a 2ml prefilled pod with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a separate 10ml refill reservoir. Once connected, the refill chamber automatically feeds the pod during use, potentially supporting up to 10,000 puffs per kit depending on vaping style. There's no need for messy refills or coil changes. The pod uses mesh coil technology for a smooth and consistent MTL vape with well-rounded flavour. Designed exclusively for the IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, setup is quick and convenient. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
